name: Related Skills
headline: LinkedIn Content: Generate Posts
short_description: This skill allows users to generate high-engagement posts for LinkedIn using the inference.sh CLI. It's ideal for marketers, content creators, and businesses looking to enhance their LinkedIn presence.
author: inference-sh

sections.overview:
This skill leverages the inference.sh CLI to generate professional, high-engagement LinkedIn content tailored for your audience. It integrates with 250+ AI models available through inference.sh, enabling marketers and content creators to produce polished posts without manual drafting. The skill is part of the broader inference.sh platform, which provides access to image generation, video creation, LLM models, and web search capabilities. Install it as a Claude Code plugin or standalone skill to streamline your LinkedIn content strategy.
Research trending LinkedIn content patterns
Generate posts with high engagement for LinkedIn
Analyze viral post examples for effective strategies
Automate LinkedIn content creation
sections.setup:
Terminal
Copy
`$ npx skills add https://github.com/inference-sh/skills --skill linkedin-content`
`git clone https://github.com/inference-sh/skills`
sections.usage:
```
Generate a high-engagement LinkedIn post for [COMPANY], a [INDUSTRY] company, based on the following key points: [KEY_POINTS]. The post should be professional yet engaging, under 150 words, and include a clear call-to-action. Use a conversational tone with emojis where appropriate.
```
Copy

```
# Unlocking the Future of [Industry] with AI-Powered Solutions 🚀

At [TechInnovate Solutions], we’re redefining how businesses in [Industry] operate—by harnessing the power of AI to drive efficiency, innovation, and growth. 💡

Over the past year, our AI-driven tools have helped [COMPANY_NAME] reduce operational costs by **30%** while boosting productivity by **40%**. Imagine what we could do for *your* business.

🔹 **Personalized AI insights**
🔹 **Automated workflows**
🔹 **Data-driven decision-making**

Ready to transform your operations? **DM us or visit [WEBSITE_LINK] to book a demo today!**

#AI #Innovation #BusinessGrowth #DigitalTransformation
```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
